verdict.rationale: Inngest's docs explicitly describe deploying function changes without explicit version markers or migration logic, and its durable-execution model checkpoints in-flight steps so runs resume from the last successful checkpoint rather than restarting on new code — together implying in-flight runs continue on their original logic while new runs pick up new code. This is corroborated by durability/memoization docs and community reports of reliable production use. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation or example specifically confirming that an in-flight run's *remaining* steps execute against the exact version of code they started with (rather than the newest deployed version) and independent/hands-on verification of this specific deploy-time behavior.
